annotations.title: Verify ownership and inspect public identity evidence

description: Non-government identity intelligence: email/DNS/wallet challenge proofs, GitHub and Bluesky public profiles, GLEIF/SEC business records, signed A2A cards and the canonical Base ERC-8004 registry. Separates ownership from public-record matches and unverified claims, with evidence, timestamps and fraud indicators. Required evidence failures refuse delivery. Existing contact screening remains available. No documents or biometrics. $3.00 per call. Returns: verification_status, verified (scoped ownership only), ownership[], findings[], profiles[], businesses[], agent, screening, correlations[], fraud_indicators[], sources[], checked_at, limitations[].

language.description: Optional BCP-47 language tag (en, ja, ko, pt-BR): the human-readable strings of the result (notes, details, reasons) are translated into this language; data, codes, numbers and URLs are untouched. Default: as produced.
